__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: Datasource collecting both the vLLM fleet exporter and LLM router

title: LLM Platform Overview
description: Router and vLLM fleet telemetry with a shared exact served-model filter. Router traffic is a subset of engine traffic when clients bypass the router. Hardware node filtering affects hardware panels only. Latency percentiles, poll averages and response-header timing remain distinct. Sizes include JSON/SSE framing, not tokens. [readability-v2] Legends and model selectors retain exact served IDs. Latency heatmaps use router histograms; engine charts show poll means. [grouping-v3] Overview groups follow operational questions; router detail distributions repeat per selected model.

panels.title: Fleet node transport
panels.description: All fleet nodes. Transport availability is distinct from sample freshness or model health.

panels.title: Router errors / rejections / cancellations
panels.description: Router-wide for the selected API route, regardless of model filter, so malformed and unknown-model rejections remain visible. Code 0 means no final response headers were written.

panels.title: Current decode per model (1m rate)
panels.description: Latest one-minute token rate, including idle time, summed per served model. This is not active-generation speed or hardware utilization. Each arc scales to that model's observed peak over the selected time range. Missing data is not zero-filled.

panels.title: Current prefill per model (1m rate)
panels.description: Latest one-minute token rate, including idle time, summed per served model. This is not active-generation speed or hardware utilization. Each arc scales to that model's observed peak over the selected time range. Missing data is not zero-filled.

panels.title: Request rates: router / engines
panels.description: Router counts finished proxied requests, including errors. Engines count all completed requests, including direct clients. Different populations: do not add, subtract, or treat their difference as lost requests.

panels.title: Router open streams
panels.description: Router in-flight requests include open streams across all API routes. Engine queues include clients that bypass the router.

panels.title: Engine running requests
panels.description: Router in-flight requests include open streams across all API routes. Engine queues include clients that bypass the router.

panels.title: Engine waiting requests
panels.description: Router in-flight requests include open streams across all API routes. Engine queues include clients that bypass the router.

panels.title: Time to first token (mean)
panels.description: Engine poll-interval mean across all clients, not a percentile. Zero may mean no observations during the poll. Model selector retains exact served IDs.

panels.title: Inter-token latency (mean)
panels.description: Engine poll-interval mean across all clients, not a percentile. Zero may mean no observations during the poll. Model selector retains exact served IDs.

panels.title: Engine end-to-end latency (mean)
panels.description: Engine poll-interval mean across all clients, not a percentile. Zero may mean no observations during the poll. Model selector retains exact served IDs.

panels.title: Full-request observations (selected range)
panels.description: Estimated observation count from counter increase, including errors and partial responses. Prometheus extrapolates between scrapes; missing data is not zero-filled.

panels.title: Header observations (selected range)
panels.description: Estimated observation count from counter increase, including errors and partial responses. Prometheus extrapolates between scrapes; missing data is not zero-filled.

panels.title: Full request latency distribution
panels.description: Non-cumulative histogram buckets across the selected models. Color shows observations/s. Errors and partial responses are included; empty cells have no observations. Includes request-body read and the full response stream; not per-token latency.

panels.title: Response-header latency distribution
panels.description: Non-cumulative histogram buckets across the selected models. Color shows observations/s. Errors and partial responses are included; empty cells have no observations. Time to final HTTP response headers, NOT time to first generated token.

panels.title: Request payload size distribution
panels.description: Bucketed request rate across selected models. Size includes all messages, JSON and inline media, not token counts. Color shows requests/s; empty cells mean no observations.

panels.title: Response payload size distribution
panels.description: Bucketed response rate across selected models. Size includes JSON/SSE framing and partial responses; no answer contents are retained. Color shows responses/s.

panels.title: Request size buckets (selected range)
panels.description: Estimated observations during the selected dashboard time range. Each bar is a disjoint payload-byte interval (exclusive lower, inclusive upper bound), including the overflow bucket. Sizes include JSON/SSE framing, not tokens. Counts may be fractional because increase() extrapolates between scrapes.

panels.title: Response size buckets (selected range)
panels.description: Estimated observations during the selected dashboard time range. Each bar is a disjoint payload-byte interval (exclusive lower, inclusive upper bound), including the overflow bucket. Sizes include JSON/SSE framing, not tokens. Counts may be fractional because increase() extrapolates between scrapes.

panels.title: Router payload traffic
panels.description: Request/response byte counters update when requests finish, including partial answers. Not network wire traffic or engine token counts.

panels.title: Host memory
panels.description: Host-level memory, counted once per node rather than once per model. The served-model filter does not affect hardware panels.

panels.title: Router endpoint discovery
panels.description: All configured endpoints. Last model-discovery result, not inference health.

panels.title: Tokens out per model over time
